description: This file defines the ByAndFinder class, which is a part of the entity finder framework in Apache OFBiz. It processes XML elements to construct entity conditions using 'AND' logic based on field mappings.

classes.name: ByAndFinder
classes.description: A class that constructs an entity condition representing an AND combination of field-value mappings extracted from an XML element.

methods.name: ByAndFinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the finder with an XML element, setting up the field mapping.

methods.name: getWhereEntityCondition
methods.description: Generates an EntityCondition based on the processed field map, expanding fields in the context and converting their types.
